'''0.13c''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that was supposed to fixed various crashes and connectivity issues. Due to a problem with the installer though, these changes were not applied until the subsequent [[0.13d]] patch.

==Changelog==
* Fixed a bug that caused it to disconnect the player from the server. This error was shown as a single_size_buffer_allocator - out of memory! message
* Fixed a server crash when calculating the rating for the player, resulting in 0 points
* Fixed a crash that could occur when picking up a box of tools at the time of resynchronization
* Fixed position of the mouse pointer when you open the options window
* Fixed a bug that caused a player wearing no items to not be displayed in the game lobby
